statements.status_notes: The vulnerability is in esbuild's Deno module (lib/deno/mod.ts), which downloads a native binary without SHA-256 integrity verification. The esbuild npm package shipped here contains only the Node.js distribution (install.js, lib/main.js); the Deno module is published separately and is not part of the package, and the image has no Deno runtime. The vulnerable code is therefore not present in what this image ships.
